title: 若帆之阁 Ruofan zhi Ge
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: 9 boxes stand in this compound, 9 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 若帆之阁
evidence.excerpt_zh: 北逺山村東北度石橋折而西為湛虛翠軒又西為耕雲堂又西為若帆之閣湛虛翠軒東數十武有闗帝廟（圓明園册）臣等謹按若帆之閣下層額曰御風泠然上額曰平臨天境與湛虛翠軒諸額皆御書
evidence.summary: North-east of 北逺山村 over a stone bridge and west: 湛虛翠軒, 耕雲堂, the two-storey 若帆之閣 with a plaque per floor, and a 闗帝廟 a little to the east.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考: 若帆之阁
evidence.excerpt_zh: 北逺山村東北度石橋折而西 ... 又西為若帆之閣

evidence.title: 御製 若帆之閣
evidence.excerpt_zh:
若帆之閣
髙閣平陵水之裔動影漪搖網軒字若帆題額真若帆下浸煙波上雲氣詎因風勢為轉旋常與月輪共光霽恰憶浮玉坐江樓孰主孰賔孰同異然予絜矩在羲經時乗六龍御天際
evidence.summary: A tall pavilion at the water's edge with lattice shadows in the ripples, named for looking like a sail.

evidence.title: 御製 若帆之閣
evidence.excerpt_zh:
若帆之閣
髙閣築溪上因之號若㠶雖云出想像體物意不凡廼兹俯凝凍顧名稱（去聲）似嫌既而囅然笑拘泥誠何堪即彼藏塢舟寧弗成虚談
evidence.summary: Winter visit: the pavilion stands on the stream, which he finds frozen, and he smiles at the name. Mentions boats kept in a boathouse.

evidence.title: 若帆之阁
evidence.locator: v3 p.182, under 若帆之阁; source ref 8-815
evidence.excerpt_zh: 高阁平陵水之裔，动影漪摇网轩字。若帆题额真若帆，下浸烟波上云气。讵因风势为转旋，常与月轮共光霁。恰忆浮玉坐江楼，孰主孰宾孰同异。然予絜矩在羲经，时乘六龙御天际。
evidence.summary: Poem 若帆之阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 若帆之阁
evidence.locator: v3 p.183, under 若帆之阁; source ref 8-825
evidence.excerpt_zh: 高阁临水名若帆，若帆妙义多包函。驹影之时阅以四，如环之运参以三。清风明月食无尽，舟行岸转疑有兼。而我取喻十思疏，更因切切畏民碞。设其肆志弗顾虑，挂席过驶危或阽。今朝西北来习习，正宜快霁因农忺。
evidence.summary: Poem 若帆之阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 题湛虚翠轩
evidence.locator: v3 p.182, under 若帆之阁; source ref 8-817
evidence.excerpt_zh: 四面窗棂弗纸糊，网轩了可隔翔乌。光明通彻内还外，顾盼真教有若无。却暑袖招凉籁拂，延清襟惹绿阴铺。一泓碧水阶前俯，心所澄然得似乎。
evidence.summary: Poem 题湛虚翠轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 耕云堂
evidence.locator: v3 p.181, under 若帆之阁; source ref 8-815
evidence.excerpt_zh: 书堂枕碧川，川水灌鳞田。目廑耕耘苦，心祈稼穑虔。益筹旸与雨，那共胝和胼。莫更屏风画，前呈七月篇。
evidence.summary: Poem 耕云堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 耕云堂
evidence.locator: v3 p.183, under 若帆之阁; source ref 9-102
evidence.excerpt_zh: 几架书堂俯水田，雨旸幸协稻芊芊。三庚屈指西成远，未敢先时庆有年。
evidence.summary: Poem 耕云堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1765, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 自花港观鱼放舟至耕云堂
evidence.locator: v3 p.192, under 若帆之阁; source ref 3-99
evidence.excerpt_zh: 柳展长条桃灼华，川湄岩角灿明霞。扁舟试放溪亭北，恍似寻芳溯若耶。
evidence.summary: Poem 自花港观鱼放舟至耕云堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 由北远山村泛舟至耕云堂观水田成什
evidence.locator: v3 p.193, under 若帆之阁; source ref 3-348
evidence.excerpt_zh: 清溪曲折泛轻航，岸沚汀兰互绚芳。林幄蝉声如和答，水村农事正匆忙。三耘冒暑诚非易，百谷登场候最长。欲识田功岂学稼，豳风雅绘在山堂。
evidence.summary: Poem 由北远山村泛舟至耕云堂观水田成什 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1807, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 北远山村泛舟至耕云堂即景成什
evidence.locator: v3 p.193, under 若帆之阁; source ref 4-254
evidence.excerpt_zh: 几转溪湾到水门，扁舟缓度北山村。烟笼柳岸汀洲暗，风拂稻畦稏翻。亦有浴波遍鹅鸭，岂同留客足鸡豚。田家景物御园备，探讨民艰重本原。
evidence.summary: Poem 北远山村泛舟至耕云堂即景成什 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1810, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 若帆之阁 北门 土地庙, 山神庙 (S47 section 2.8)
evidence.summary: An order of 1734 places an earth god in a small one-bay room west of the north-gate Guandi temple, and a mountain god in the fold of the hills west of the north gate. Both sit close inside the north gate of the garden.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 若帆之阁
evidence.summary: Begun 1764 within the great north gate: a square two-storey tower of three bays, 安止楼, a square half-in-water pavilion 碧澜亭, 耕云堂 on a rockery, 爽籁居, 湛虚翠轩, a stone bridge and 关帝庙. 耕云堂 survived 1860 and was lost around 1900, say the editors.

evidence.title: 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 若帆之阁
evidence.date: mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher
evidence.locator: 初编 目录: 若帆之阁, pp.405-414
evidence.summary: The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at pp.405-414 (10 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.

evidence.title: 圆明园总平面图
evidence.date: 乾隆四十至四十二年绘, 改至道光十一年 (1775-1831)
evidence.locator: 故宫博物院图书馆 样1704号
evidence.summary: Large overall base plan of Yuanming Yuan, ink and light colour with pasted slips, 1761x1311 mm, drawn c. 1775-77 and altered until 1831, so its layers must be read apart; at Tianran Tuhua the pool is painted out in white. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

evidence.title: 圆明园新证, 端木泓: dated additions shown on plan 1704
evidence.summary: Tables of when things were added, drawn from archives to date the plan's layers: 藻园 1752, 廓然大公 eight views 1754, 春雨轩 1755, 藏密楼 1758, 多稼轩 ten views 1759, 紫碧山房 1760, 安澜园 and 澄练楼 1763, 若帆之阁 1764, 汇万总春之庙 1769, 文源阁 1775, 法源楼 1779; after: 兰亭八柱 1779, 知过堂 1782, 课农轩 1816, 涵月楼 1827. The most useful single dating table found.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
